items.title: Example 1
items.sub: On building things that run without you
items.desc: A practical account of the systems that keep good work moving when your attention is somewhere else. It runs from first principles down to the small operational details that decide whether a process survives contact with a real week.

items.title: Example 2
items.desc: A field guide to deciding under uncertainty: how to weigh partial evidence, size a bet honestly, and recognise the point where waiting for more information costs more than acting without it.

items.title: Example 3
items.sub: Twelve essays on patience as strategy
items.desc: Twelve essays on the long game â compounding attention, resisting the urge to restart, and letting good work accrue. Short pieces meant to be read one at a time and returned to often.

items.title: PCI DSS Readiness
items.sub: Gap assessment through to a QSA-ready report.
items.desc: A full gap assessment against the current PCI DSS requirements, followed by scope reduction, evidence collection, and a remediation plan your team can actually work through. It ends with a readiness report you can hand to a QSA without rewriting it first.

items.title: GRC Program Build
items.sub: Policies, risk register, and control mapping.
items.desc: Policies, a live risk register, and control mapping against whichever framework you are held to — NIST RMF SP-800, ISO, or HIPAA. Built so the controls stay maintainable after the engagement ends, rather than documented once and left to rot.

items.title: Security Assessment
items.sub: Identity, endpoints, and Active Directory reviewed.
items.desc: A configuration review across identity, endpoints, and Active Directory, tested against the way your organisation actually operates. Findings come ranked by exploitability and effort to fix, so the list is a work plan rather than a scanner dump.
